nodes.title: Prepare H3 Generation
widgets_values: Generate a cinematic shot following the supplied structural control timeline.

Choose exactly one structural type in **Control Type + Provider**: `canny`, `depth`, `hed`, `mlsd`, or `pose`. This is one execution path, not five branches.

The selected control resource must be a canonical `control_video` and must declare the same type in `extensions.minimax_h3.control.control_kind`. A missing or different type is an error; the workflow never silently substitutes another mode. Keep `preprocessor_name` provenance consistent as well (for the stock placeholders use `external_canny`, `external_depth`, `external_hed`, `external_mlsd`, or `external_pose`).

Model selection is explicit too: `fun_controlnet_union_int8_convrot` requires an INT8 ConvRot H3 Fun checkpoint; `fun_controlnet_union_bf16` requires BF16. **Compatible H3 Fun Control Model** validates the loaded checkpoint against that provider and the base model instead of falling back.

Strength/start/end and temporal policy in **Control Type + Provider** apply to the selected control. Default is Canny + INT8 ConvRot, strict timeline, strength 1.0 over the full denoise interval.

H3 Sampling owns the acceleration adapter and records the actual LoRA hash. Turbo 4 uses the matching FL2V recipe. Select Standard - 20 steps for stock sampling.

F16 runtime compatibility is not established by this static workflow merge; execute a dedicated runtime validation before claiming support.
